name: com.shichusuimeikeisan/four-pillars
title: Shichu Suimei Keisan — Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) Calculator
description: Calculate Japanese Four Pillars (BaZi) natal charts, Ten Gods, Five Elements & compatibility.

tools.name: calculate_four_pillars
tools.description: Compute a Japanese Four Pillars of Destiny (Shichu Suimei / BaZi) natal chart from Gregorian birth date, gender, and optional birth time and birthplace coordinates. Returns Year/Month/Day/Hour pillars, Heavenly Stems & Earthly Branches (天干・地支), Ten Gods (通変星), Twelve Life Stages (十二運星), Hidden Stems (蔵干), Five Elements distribution (五行), Tenchusatsu void branches (空亡・天中殺), Luck Pillars (大運), Chart Strength (旺衰), Inner Structure (格局), Pillar Relations, and Special Stars (神殺).

birthDate.description: Gregorian birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1990-05-15'.

gender.description: Gender ('male' or 'female'), required to determine forward/reverse Luck Pillar (大運) direction.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:mm format, e.g. '14:30'. Omit if unknown to compute the Three Pillars (三柱).

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for true solar time correction (must be provided together with 'longitude'), e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo' or 'America/New_York'. Defaults to Japan Standard Time (Asia/Tokyo, 135°E) when both are omitted.

longitude.description: Optional birthplace longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180, east positive, e.g. 139.6917 for Tokyo). Must be provided together with 'timezone' and 'birthTime'.

lateRatRule.description: Rule for 23:00-23:59 births: 'split' (夜子時, default: same-day Day Pillar, next-day Hour Stem), 'same' (same day for both), or 'nextDay' (next day for both).

equationOfTime.description: Whether to include the Equation of Time in true solar time correction when birthplace timezone/longitude are supplied. Defaults to true.

tools.name: calculate_compatibility
tools.description: Compute Japanese Four Pillars (Shichu Suimei / BaZi) compatibility between two people from their Gregorian birth dates and optional birth times. Returns Day Stem relation (干合・相生・比和・相剋), Day & Month Branch relations (支合・半会・冲・刑・害・破), mutual Ten Gods (通変星), complementary Five Elements (五行), and shared Tenchusatsu (空亡).

birthDate.description: Person A Gregorian birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1990-05-15'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time (JST) in HH:mm format.

birthDate.description: Person B Gregorian birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '1992-08-20'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time (JST) in HH:mm format.
